comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see the pickup times your kitchen can really meet. The system takes into account each dish’s prep time and how many you make at once.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and day you are there.
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no lock-in and no notice period. You can cancel whenever you like; the fee is charged monthly in advance, and you keep access until the end of the month you paid for.
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till system and is not certified under the tax rules for tills. How to record online orders in your till system is something to check with your accountant.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a certified till system?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes online orders before customers reach the food truck: they choose the dishes and a pickup time, pay online or on collection, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till system or card reader takes payment at the food truck. The two complement each other.

Wolt says on its own website that it charges commission but gives no rates. We could not check Lieferando’s rates. That commission also applies to regulars who pre-order from you.

faq.phrases.appsOffline: The iPad and Android app keeps taking walk-up orders without signal and sends them when you’re back online; the web dashboard needs a connection.
faq.phrases.appsSentence: There is also an iPad and Android app, which keeps taking walk-up orders if you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers pre-order for a future date or time, before the event.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Assign a buzzer number to the order when you hand it over, so you know which buzzer goes with which order.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place, such as food hygiene, insurance and gas safety. We warn you before anything expires and you can send them to an event or market organiser with one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each links straight to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen (KDS), and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Say how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a slot fills up, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward repeat customers with digital stamp cards — stamps add up and are redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Bundle dishes into combos and offer extras at checkout to raise the average ticket.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — counter and kitchen — with the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give your team their own login with the right permission level.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose signal, online orders pause so nobody places orders you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you keep taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment up front when customers order online, through Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a cut-off time for dishes that need preparing in advance.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t appear on the map, with their own ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter what each dish costs you and find out what you really earned at each event, not just what you took.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill your schedule automatically — from your website or from a picture you already post on Facebook. You just check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Text customers automatically when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add your dates, places and times for every week and every event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any dish sold out with one tap — it greys out for customers instantly.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set your stock and it counts down with each order; at zero the dish sells out by itself.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a compatible phone, with no separate card reader needed.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose their pickup time within a time slot, so demand is spread across the service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the window, paid on your own card reader.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.
